---
title: "List Vendors"
api: "GET https://api.smartbills.io/v1/vendors"
description: "Retrieve a paginated list of vendors"
---

## Authentication

<ParamField header="Authorization" type="string" required>
  Bearer token for authentication
</ParamField>

## Required Scopes

- `vendors.read`

## Query Parameters

<ParamField query="page" type="integer" default="1">
  Page number
</ParamField>

<ParamField query="pageSize" type="integer" default="100">
  Items per page (max: 100)
</ParamField>

<ParamField query="search" type="string">
  Search by name or website
</ParamField>

<RequestExample>

```bash cURL
curl --request GET \
  --url 'https://api.smartbills.io/v1/vendors?page=1&pageSize=20' \
  --header 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY'
```

```javascript JavaScript
const response = await client.vendors.list({
  page: 1,
  pageSize: 20
});
```

```python Python
response = client.vendors.list(page=1, page_size=20)
```

```csharp C#
var response = await client.Vendors.ListAsync(new VendorListRequest
{
    Page = 1,
    PageSize = 20
});
```

</RequestExample>

<ResponseExample>

```json Response
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 12345,
      "name": "Acme Supplies Inc.",
      "website": "https://acmesupplies.com",
      "createdAt": "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z"
    }
  ],
  "metadata": {
    "page": 1,
    "pageSize": 20,
    "totalPages": 4,
    "count": 78
  }
}
```

</ResponseExample>
